a.xlink:title: USBD_StdEPReq Handle standard usb endpoint requests.
USBD_CtlError Handle USB low level Error.
Sets a Stall condition on an endpoint of the Low Level Driver.
USBD_CtlSendData send data on the ctl pipe.
USBD_CtlSendStatus send zero lzngth packet on the ctl pipe.
Clears a Stall condition on an endpoint of the Low Level Driver.
Set a STALL condition over an endpoint.
Returns the USB status depending on the HAL status:
Prepare the EP0 to start the first control setup.
USB_EPSetStall set a stall condition over an EP.
USB_EPStartXfer setup and starts a transfer over an EP.
Copy a buffer from user memory area to packet memory area (PMA).
Clear a STALL condition over in an endpoint.
USB_EPClearStall Clear a stall condition over an EP.
